text:
```yaml
name: Publish Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Create release notes
      id: create_release_notes
      run: echo "::set-output name=release_notes::$(npm run generate-release-notes)"

    - name: Publish to Docker Hub
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v3
      with:
        context: .
        push: true
        tags: gotalab/cc-sdd:${{ github.sha }}
        labels: |
          version=${{ github.ref_name }}
          build-date=${{ github.event.created_at }}

    - name: Update README description
      uses: peter-evans/dockerhub-description@v4
      with:
        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}
        repository: gotalab/cc-sdd
        short-description: "Minimal human approval gates in AI-DLC process"
        readme-filepath: README.md
        enable-url-completion: true
        image-extensions: .png,.jpg,.jpeg,.gif

    - name: Commit and push changes
      uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
      with:
        add: README.md
        commit: "Update README description and publish Docker image"
        author_name: GitHub Actions
        author_email: actions@github.com
        push: true
```
